messages:
alia: quick heads-up — ran `npm audit` against the console-ui bundle after the build-image bump. found one high-sev in a devtool we vendor for builds.

samir: which package? can we patch without touching lockfile? :eyes:

alia: it's `esbuild-devtools` (transitive through our build-scripts). flagged as CVE-2025-3421 — impacts prototype pollution in the CLI parsing layer. npm shows a patched 0.17.x.

becky: is this hitting prod? we only ship compiled artifacts, right?

alia: not at runtime — it's a devDependency used in our CI/node image to bundle. risk is supply-chain / CI compromise and attacker getting build artifacts if the CI machine is compromised. per policy we treat high devdep vulns as P1 for build-image owners.

paul: OK — we should coordinate with infra. two concerns: lockfile churn if we run `pnpm up` across the monorepo, and potential CI flakes from esbuild minor. propose: patch esbuild-devtools in a narrow canary branch that only updates that transitive, run full CI + e2e on canary.

alia: agree. i ran a minimal repro:
```
$ npm audit --json | jq '.advisories["CVE-2025-3421"]'
{
  "module_name": "esbuild-devtools",
  "severity": "high",
  "patched_versions": ">=0.17.19",
  "path": "console-ui > build-scripts > esbuild-devtools"
}
```

samir: if the patched version is 0.17.19, should be low risk. can we pin only the transitive to the patched version via overrides (pnpmfile / packageManager overrides) to avoid lock churn?

paul: yes — pnpm & yarn v3+ support overrides. for our repo (pnpm workspace) i can add a `pnpm.overrides` entry for `esbuild-devtools@*`: `0.17.19` and then run `pnpm install --lockfile-only` in canary branch. that should limit churn.

becky: timeline? product wants to release a patch Monday — do we need to delay?

alia: doesn't affect user-facing code. plan is:
1) paul opens canary branch and adds override + lockfile-only install
2) samir updates build-image reference in that branch to the new image that has the patched devtool, runs CI
3) run internal release smoke e2e (30m)
4) merge and backfill any regression fixes to main if needed

paul: i'll open the branch now: `git switch -c fix/esbuild-cve-3421` and add: 
```json
{"pnpm": {"overrides": {"esbuild-devtools": "0.17.19"}}}
```
then `pnpm install --lockfile-only` + push.

deploy-bot: deploy-check: canary pipeline triggered for fix/esbuild-cve-3421 — 3 jobs queued.

samir: i'll run the build locally against the canary image and smoke the bundle. if any breakage i'll report here.

alia: thanks. follow-up actions: file a short incident ticket for the dependency patch (security triage), add a note to the build-image changelog, and create a post-merge job to scan for other high-sev devdep vulns monthly.

becky: sounds good. please @me when merged so we can continue the Monday release. :thumbsup:

paul: PR up: https://github.com/redwood-inference/console-ui/pull/4827 — includes override + updated lockfile (minimal changes). CI green on canary.

alia: reviewed the lock diff — minimal. moving to approve after samir confirms local smoke.

samir: smoke passed. no bundle size diffs, no runtime regressions in storybook. approving now.

alia: merging and filing follow-ups (ticket SEC-1229). thanks everyone. :rocket:
